title: NBA: only lean on totals with a 5-point edge
finding: Our NBA total leans are 3 of 8 (38%), and our projected totals miss the final total by 16.8 points on average against 16.6 for the posted line, so the model adds nothing on totals yet.
evidence: 36 graded NBA games, 29 Oct to 2 Nov. Small sample: worth acting on cautiously.
suggestion: Raise the gap needed for a Lean over or Lean under from 2 points to 5 points; below that the total stays a Coin toss.

title: NFL: show spread picks only with a 3-point edge
finding: Our NFL spread picks are 6 of 13 (46%), below the 52.4% needed to break even at normal prices, while winner picks are 10 of 13.
evidence: 13 graded NFL games, week 8. Small sample.
suggestion: Only make a spread pick when our projected margin differs from the spread by 3 points or more; otherwise mark it 'No edge'.

title: Football: tighten both-teams-to-score picks
finding: Both-teams-to-score picks are 4 of 9 (44%). Most were made at 50 to 60% model chance, where the pick is close to a coin flip.
evidence: 18 graded Premier League and La Liga games, 31 Oct to 2 Nov.
suggestion: Pick 'Both score' only at 60% or more and 'Not both' only at 40% or less; in between call it a Coin toss.

title: All sports: winner chances look slightly too cautious
finding: In every sport we won a little more often than our stated chances predicted: NBA 25 wins against 23.9 expected, NFL 10 against 8.1, football 12 against 9.3, UFC 8 against 6.9.
evidence: 78 graded picks. Too few to change anything yet; the 11 pm review will keep checking.
suggestion: No change now. If the gap holds after 150 graded picks, nudge win chances about 3 points further from 50%.

title: Football: make a goals bet the main play
finding: Total-goals picks are 11 of 17 (65%), and over 1.5 goals landed 8 of 10 times when we gave it 75% or more. Winner picks are often close calls (39 to 48% tonight), so they make a weaker headline.
evidence: 29 graded Premier League, La Liga and Champions League games, 31 Oct to 4 Nov.
suggestion: Each card leads with one goals play: the market (over/under 1.5, 2.5, 3.5 or both teams to score) whose chance is at least 62% and furthest above how often it happens (by 5 points or more), plus the safest line at 75% or more. Otherwise 'No strong goals play'.

title: Football: our both-teams-to-score chances are too high
finding: We gave both teams to score about 57% on average, but both teams scored in only 9 of 29 games (31%). 'Both score' picks are 8 of 20; tonight they were 1 of 8.
evidence: 29 graded football games, 31 Oct to 4 Nov. This goes further than the 2 Nov suggestion to tighten the threshold.
suggestion: Rebuilt to the owner's spec (4 Nov): both teams to score now comes from each side's scoring and conceding rates at the venue, matched against the opponent's, shots and shots on target for and against, past meetings, and key attackers or defenders out. 'Both score' at 60% or more, 'Not both' at 40% or less.

title: Football: lean on the bookmaker for winners
finding: On the 11 football games with saved pre-game numbers, the bookmaker's favourite won 9, our form model's favourite 5, and our 50/50 blend 7. Tonight the model flipped two picks away from the market (Atlético over Bayern, Roma over United) and both missed. The model also picked the home side in 7 of 9 games.
evidence: 11 archived football games plus tonight's 9 Champions League games. A small sample, but the gap is large.
suggestion: Blend winner chances 75% bookmaker and 25% form model (now 50/50), and never let the model flip the bookmaker's favourite unless the model is 15 points or more the other way.
